interventions.speaker: EXPERT-EAU
interventions.who: EAU guideline specialist; speaks only from the guideline text he retrieved
interventions.body:
GUIDELINE
The EAU guidelines suggest that the decision for repeat biopsy depends on the MRI findings and other risk factors. "sion on MRI mandates a repeat biopsy to confirm histological progression before a change in treatment strategy." The guidelines also state that factors like low PSA density and PSA velocity can be used to individualize the need for biopsy.

WHAT THE EXPERTS' BIDS DO NOT SETTLE
EXPERT-STRUCTURED, I see that the guideline treats the variable 'PSA density' as context, whereas EXPERT-STRUCTURED marked it as 'not used' with 'clear' confidence. The guideline suggests using PSA density to individualize the need for biopsy, which the guideline makes decisive for a man like this one. The guideline requires the prior grade of the biopsy, which no panel variable represents.

WHAT THE DOCUMENTS MUST SETTLE
previous_notes - the prior biopsy status: at Negative the guideline suggests that the incidence of PCa is higher after a negative systematic biopsy, meaning the indication stands.
radiology_report - whether the lesion is compared against an earlier study: unchanged does not support re-sampling, new or larger does
psa_trend - the PSA velocity: the guideline suggests low PSA velocity can be used to individualize the need for biopsy.
laboratory_results - the PSA density: the guideline suggests PSA density can be used to individualize the need for biopsy.

interventions.body:
Expert 2 here — the PSA projector. I read only the serial PSA the registrar opened.

TRAJECTORY: INDETERMINATE (uncertain). Last value 6.00 ng/mL over 3 points spanning 14 months; velocity +3.00 ng/mL per year; doubling time about 11 months.
PROJECTION at 6 months: 7.3 ng/mL, conformal 95% band 2.1-25.5.

Read the band before the point: it is wide by construction, and I only call a direction when the whole
band clears the last value. This does not vote on the biopsy — a rising PSA in a man with a known
diagnosis is the disease behaving as known — it tells the chair how fast the number is moving.
